title: Eye Strain Timer (20-20-20)
description: A 20-20-20 rule timer for screen workers: work 20 minutes, then rest your eyes 20 seconds looking 20 feet away.
howto: Press Start to begin a 20-minute focus block.
When it ends, look at something 20 feet away for the 20-second rest.
The cycle repeats automatically; completed breaks are counted.

faqs.a: Every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet (6 m) away for 20 seconds. It relaxes the focusing muscle and reminds you to blink.
Yes — use the focus-length field if your workflow needs 25 or 30 minute blocks. The 20-second rest stays per the rule.

faqs.q: Does this replace eye drops or glasses?
faqs.a: No. It reduces strain but persistent dryness, headaches or blurred vision deserve an eye exam.
